raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The v2 collector emits txn_ts in UTC while legacy emits America/Chicago local time, and silver_transactions uses txn_ts unchanged. v2 rows are therefore shifted forward about 6 hours, which pushes evening local activity into 00:00-06:00 of the next calendar day and creates the phantom 2026-01-19 volume and off-hours timestamps. Converting v2 timestamps from UTC to America/Chicago local time in silver, before deriving txn_date, makes both collectors share one convention.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.72, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT txn_id, customer_id, merchant_id, amount, txn_ts, CAST(txn_ts AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM (SELECT CAST(txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, customer_id, CAST(merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(amount AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CASE WHEN collector = 'v2' THEN CAST(timezone('America/Chicago', timezone('UTC', CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP))) AS TIMESTAMP) ELSE CAST(txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) END AS txn_ts FROM raw_transactions WHERE status = 'POSTED') t;"}}
